text: Page Six may be compensated and/or receive an affiliate commission if you click or buy through our links. Featured pricing is subject to change. Summertime is the time to unwind and get away. If you’re planning to get out of Dodge, it may be time to pick up some new luggage. During Amazon Prime Day , we spotted the celeb-approved Away brand on sale, making it the perfect reason to shop. You’ll be in good company; stars like Sydney Sweeney, Dakota Johnson, Margot Robbie and Kaia Gerber are just a few of the A-listers who glide through airports with the brand. Stars use the UK’s No. 1 cleansing balm, and it’s 30% off for Prime Day Whether you’re looking for a carry-on for a quick jaunt or you’re not coming back until September, Away has luxe suitcases of all sizes in select colors on sale. Not just good looks, the lightweight 100% polycarbonate shell is tough, the wheels glide effortlessly, and the suitcases have an innovative compression system to pack more. Oui, oui! Stars adore these French pharmacy beauty staples, and they’re on sale for Prime Day If you’ve ever upgraded your luggage, you know the world of difference it makes to have an easily managed suitcase on trips short and long, making it more than worth the investment. Away makes beautiful and functional travel pieces that I know will become my new best travel companions. Can’t wait to take them on another trip soon!” When it comes to luggage, function over style; however, these are quite streamlined, like the sports cars of suitcases. Away suitcases also make great gifts. These significant savings of up to 20% off won’t last forever. Prime Days are only through July 11, so splurge a little while saving.
